name: 주도주 피라미딩

rules.watch: theme breadth + flu/vol spike + RS>index; WATCH only until TRADE unlock
rules.scout: 1 share on breakout/setup while close>SMA20 and gap<=5%; hard stop -8% or setup low / SMA20 2d
rules.add: only when pnl>0 and uptrend SMA5>10>20; pullback 38-62% or SMA10 touch; qty 2 then 3 then 4; max 3 adds; no averaging down
rules.trim: close<SMA10 sells adds; close<SMA20 or setup low or trail -12% from peak flattens; optional +15% sell 25%

fill.btNote: v2 LDR-PYR: ONeil/Minervini/Livermore style leader scout+pullback pyramid+MA exit; paperOnly

notes: v2. 모의 전용(paperOnly). 실주문 엔진은 당분간 MMG01(manualMgrLive) 모의 기동으로 피라미딩 실행. LDR01은 스펙·탭·복기 기준.
